What SK CORE is

SK CORE is a directory, not a platform that stores your data: each SK product keeps running as its own independent website, with its own accounts and its own domain. This page only lists them and links to them.

  • One catalog that lists every SK product and where to find it.
  • Each product stays independently deployed and independently operated.
  • New products are registered in a single configuration file, so the catalog grows without a redesign.
